The types of Pokémon match up differently with
each other.\c
Based on its types, your Pokémon may be strong
against one opponent and weak against another.
I sold a Nugget that I had no use for, and I got\n₽5,000 for it!
I heard that some kind of ghost has been\nappearing in Lavender Town.\c\nEveryone’s talking about it!

I’m an Ace Trainer!\c
You’ll find that Ace Trainers like me are a lot
tougher to beat than your ordinary Trainers.\c
Be ready for a real challenge if you let one of
us spot you!
There’s a magazine titled Speculation Monthly:\nTales to Be Taken with a Grain of Salt!

“This report reached us from a reader wishing
to remain anonymous. They had this to say:
‘It happened when I went to the Pokémon Tower.
I’d been visiting a grave there, and when I went
to leave, a mysterious dark figure appeared and
chased me! I couldn’t tell what it was, and I tried
as desperately as I could to run away, but in the
end, it caught me anyway...
Then the next thing I knew, I was lying on the
ground outside of the tower’s entrance.
What in the world was that thing?’”
